response.text:
Here are the deadlines coming up in October:

- **Return overdue library items** – due Fri 2 Oct 2026, with Stadtbibliothek Musterstadt [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149] [party:pty_d2ymm5s3htd0]. The letter says fees increase 0,50 € per item per opening day after the deadline, with the account blocked once fees reach 10,00 € [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149].

- **Object to contribution notice (Widerspruch)** with Muster BKK – due Wed 14 Oct 2026, send by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_v0kx33tjwnwb] [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3]. If not filed in time, the notice becomes final.

- **Tax objection deadline (Einspruchsfrist)** with Finanzamt Musterstadt – due Wed 21 Oct 2026, send by Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ddxnhb06rr9h] [party:pty_mcq97yavgqjy]. If missed, the tax assessment becomes final and can no longer be challenged.

For the two send-by deadlines, note the send-by dates are earlier than the due dates to allow for post — plan accordingly. If in doubt about either objection, it may be worth getting advice before the send-by date.
